g.title: sense
g.text: screen 640x480 RGB | depth buffer | labels (visible things) | automap (seen lines only) | HUD variables

g.title: nav
g.text: world raster 4 u/px, 32-unit cells, Dijkstra, targets: exit > key > goal item > frontier > walls

g.title: status
g.text: health, armor, ammo, position, heading, enemy bearing/distance,
clearances, route bearing/distance, target kind, stuck, use-ahead,
level, keys, navigator mode, doors known ... @ 12 Hz

g.title: comp
g.text: TCP client to the payload; parses STATUS -> 44 telemetry channels (tlmWrite),
splits JPEG into FrameChunk records (960 B) -> Fw::Com buffers

g.title: tm
g.text: CCSDS Space Packets (APID 1 telemetry, 2 events, 3 file)
in fixed 1024 B TM frames, UDP to the ground

g.title: ctrlc
g.text: CONTROL(move I8, strafe I8, turn F32 deg, fire, use, weapon)
SET_GOAL(Goal) RESET_GAME FRAME_RATE(hz, quality) EXPLORE_HINT(bearing, ttl)

g.title: yamcs
g.text: Yamcs: TM decoding, archive (RocksDB), realtime processor,
parameter WebSocket, command HTTP API, bucket 'doomframes'

g.title: mdb
g.text: generated by fprime-xtce from the F´ JSON dictionary:
148 parameters, 54 commands, FrameChunk as a binary parameter

g.title: ground
g.text: DoomFrame URL, FrameSeq, SystemOneLatencyMs, Controls, Plan ...

g.title: openmct
g.text: Open MCT: plots of telemetry, DoomFrame image (yamcs.image)

g.title: words
g.text: threat, space ahead/left/right, aim offset, health, ammo, navigator mode ...

g.title: cmd
g.text: (turn degrees from the graph's turn table)

g.title: log
g.text: (answers, confidence, request id, latency, telemetry snapshot)

g.title: aar
g.text: outcome, level, health, damage, stuck/flip patterns, per-head answer stats, last moments

g.title: sonnet
g.text: claude -p --json-schema: report + current graph -> revised graph config
(wording, criteria, thresholds, turn sizes, standing order) + rationale

g.title: graphcfg
g.text: validated by code, hot-swapped for the next episode
